The '''Targeter ranging scope''' was an aiming device that was mounted atop a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. It increased accuracy by magnifying targets and superimposing a laser aim point on the image. Ostensibly it was meant for target and competition shooters, although it proved popular for [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].<ref name="ROE" />
